newsitem.title: USA: Conference Board's Fosler upbeat on U.S. stocks.
newsitem.headline: Conference Board's Fosler upbeat on U.S. stocks.

text.p: The stock market is likely to be erratic this year but investors can expect continued high returns over a three- to four-year horizon, Conference Board chief economist Gail Fosler said on Tuesday.
"These are the best economic times in a generation," Fosler told the National Assocation of Purchasing Management. "We're going to see very, very high rates of return."
She saw no risk of a significant rise in inflation or a major downturn in the economy through the end of this century.
